mechanism: Both agents have bradycardic effects; sacubitril (via neprilysin inhibition) enhances natriuretic peptide signaling which can reduce heart rate, while ivabradine directly inhibits the If current in SA node, creating additive negative chronotropic effects.
action: Monitor heart rate closely during concurrent use; consider dose adjustment of ivabradine if symptomatic bradycardia develops; ensure adequate baseline cardiac function assessment.
